## Agent skills

- [oh-my-fde](https://fde-group.github.io/oh-my-fde/.well-known/agent-skills/oh-my-fde/SKILL.md): Read the oh-my-fde 文档 docs instead of answering from memory. omfde（Pi 的企业内部 FDE 平台）项目文档、仓库 Wiki 与架构知识卡，供人与 coding agent 双读。 Use when a task involves oh-my-fde 文档: how it works, how to set it up or configure it, or its API.

## Agent resources

- [llms-full.txt](https://fde-group.github.io/oh-my-fde/llms-full.txt): The full Markdown of every page in one file.
- [Page Markdown](https://fde-group.github.io/oh-my-fde/index.md): Append `.md` to any page URL to fetch that page as raw Markdown.
- [JSON API](https://fde-group.github.io/oh-my-fde/api/docs/pages.json): Page index of the JSON docs API; each entry links the page's JSON and Markdown forms. Described by the OpenAPI document at https://fde-group.github.io/oh-my-fde/openapi.json.
- [Agent skills](https://fde-group.github.io/oh-my-fde/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Agent Skills discovery index of the skills this site publishes.
- [API catalog](https://fde-group.github.io/oh-my-fde/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset of the APIs documented here.
- [AI catalog](https://fde-group.github.io/oh-my-fde/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): ARD manifest of the agent-facing resources on this site (MCP server, skills, APIs).
- [agent-readability.json](https://fde-group.github.io/oh-my-fde/agent-readability.json): Manifest of every agent-facing artifact on this site.
- [Sitemap](https://fde-group.github.io/oh-my-fde/sitemap.xml): Every indexable page URL with its last-modified date.
